How a chronograph actually works: Omega Speedmaster 310.30.42.50.01.002 and Rolex Daytona 126500LN.

A chronograph has a start pusher that sets the second hand moving; pressing it again stops the timing. A reset pusher returns the hands to zero. Inside, a column wheel (or a heart-shaped cam) advances one step with each press.

Prices: Speedmaster US$9,000 on the Omega US site; Daytona 126500LN US$16,900 (B.C. Clark, 20 Nov 2026).
